findings.message: GO-02 の「評価エラーを黙殺しない」という意図を決定的に証明する AC がない。AC-04 は返却済みの失敗 verdict の schema を検証するだけで、評価処理自体がエラーを返す場合の伝播や非零終了を扱わないため、この目標の一部を未検証のまま完了扱いできる。
findings.category: missing AC coverage for a stated goal

findings.message: CN-04 の「error 出力が判定根拠を追跡可能にする」は、追跡可能と判定するための必須情報や観測条件を定義していない。IN-05 は cache 行の `bound_tests` だけを具体化しており error 出力は具体化されないため、下流工程が意味を発明しなければ検証できない制約になっている。

AC-07 は verifier provider の解決失敗時における `evaluate` のエラー伝播を要求しているが、IN-01〜IN-05 の declared in_scope は cache entry の選択、重複、binding、失敗 verdict schema、cache 診断情報に限られ、provider 解決や評価エラー伝播を含まない。したがって、この AC は宣言された in_scope 外の振る舞いを完了条件にしている。

`domain::EdgeVerdictRecord` removes `verdict_reason` without adding a nested verdict. Its remaining `outcome: EdgeResolutionOutcome` carries only the failure category, so evaluation failure records cannot represent the required `entries[].verdict.reason` from IN-04/AC-04. Declare a companion modification that preserves the complete typed verdict and its reason.

`domain::ObligationFulfillmentCacheEntry::new` requires `bound_tests`, but pre-track cache rows do not contain that newly added field, and the referenced cache port exposes no typed legacy-row/migration outcome. Such rows cannot be decoded into the declared domain type, preventing `evaluate` from loading and rewriting them as required by AC-06 without treating the cache as generically malformed.

`domain::ObligationFulfillmentCacheEntry::new` accepts the key and diagnostic `bound_tests` independently. A caller can therefore pair a key whose `bound_tests_set_hash` was computed from set A with diagnostic set B, creating a cache row whose recorded evidence contradicts its key. Group the locations and their derived hash behind one validated type/factory while keeping locations outside equality semantics.

Voluntary-binding enforcement has conflicting owners: `domain::ObligationsDocument` declares `validate_voluntary_binding` and `domain::TestBindingConsistencyError` says that method constructs the rejection, while `usecase::CheckTestObligationsInteractor` claims to validate it and `usecase::EvaluateTestObligationsInteractor` claims to reject it. Name the domain method as the sole enforcement owner and describe the interactors as invoking/propagating it.

`domain::ObligationFulfillmentCachePort` models external cache load/save I/O as fully synchronous, but its docs do not acknowledge or justify that color choice. The contract needs to record why blocking I/O is intentional, or expose an asynchronous port before adapters and callers are fixed to the synchronous shape.

The TypeEntries for `usecase::CheckTestObligationsInteractor`, `usecase::EvaluateTestObligationsInteractor`, and `usecase::TestObligationResultsInteractor` are marked `modify`, although their declared public type and constructor signatures exactly match the rustdoc baseline. Only their application-service implementations change, already represented by the separate trait-impl entries; these TypeEntries should be `reference`.

`infrastructure::JsonObligationFulfillmentCacheCodec` is marked `modify`, but its declared struct and `new(PathBuf) -> Self` surface are identical to the rustdoc baseline. The behavioral port-implementation change is represented separately, and the DTO carries the actual structural wire change, so this TypeEntry should be `reference`.

The docs for `domain::EdgeVerdictRecord`, `domain::FulfillmentCacheLookupError`, `domain::ObligationCheckError`, `domain::ObligationEvaluateError`, `domain::ObligationFulfillmentCacheDocument`, `domain::ObligationFulfillmentCacheEntry`, `domain::ObligationsDocument`, and `domain::TestBindingConsistencyError` restate upstream behavioral rules in prose. Replace these restatements with concise type/change identification and rely on their `spec_refs`, as required by `no-upstream-restatement.md`.

The docs for `infrastructure::JsonObligationFulfillmentCacheCodec` and `infrastructure::ObligationFulfillmentCacheEntryDto` repeat the upstream contracts for nested reasons, diagnostic-only bound tests, and lookup delegation. Those behaviors must remain in the cited spec anchors rather than being duplicated in catalogue prose.

The docs for all three usecase interactors restate cache-selection, voluntary-binding, diagnostic-persistence, and verdict-reason behavior from the spec. Reduce the docs to type/change identification and anchor through `spec_refs` instead of duplicating the behavioral contract.

`domain::ResolvedBoundTests::new` receives only `NonEmptyTestLocations` but exposes a `BoundTestsSetHash`. The existing hash is calculated from scanned test bodies through the usecase `ContentHasherPort`; locations contain neither those bodies nor their hash. This signature therefore cannot construct the required value without fabricating a different hash, causing valid cache entries to fail `try_new` or carry incorrect identity. Accept the already computed `BoundTestsSetHash` alongside the locations.

`domain::ResolvedBoundTests` declares `new`, `set_hash`, and `locations` twice: in the top-level `inherent_impls` entry and again in `types.ResolvedBoundTests.methods`. The v5 encoder materializes these as separate inherent impl blocks, while the implementation can contain only one method set, so the final catalogue/implementation contract will diverge. Keep the signatures in one declaration location.

`domain::ResolvedBoundTests` restates the IN-05/CN-04 contract by asserting in prose that locations are diagnostic data outside equality. Under `no-upstream-restatement.md`, retain only a concise type-purpose label and leave this behavioral/identity rule to `spec_refs`.
`plan.summary` restates the upstream goal and behavioral contract instead of using only task/operation/anchor traceability text.
Section S1 description restates design rationale and behavior (`self-hosting gate`, order-dependent lookup, and repaired-gate sequencing); retain only target, operation, and anchor cite.
Section S2 description restates the recovery behavior and manual-cache constraint rather than providing executable task attribution only.
Section S3 description restates the ownership-validation behavior and fixture expectations already defined upstream.
Section S4 description restates the cache-identity design constraint (`diagnostics outside cache identity`) instead of limiting the plan text to target, operation, and anchor cite.

Task T001 includes upstream behavioral rationale (`fail-closed ambiguity outcome`, freshness semantics, and duplicate-row behavior) beyond target + operation + anchor cite. Cite `knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md`.

Task T002 restates the upstream cache-reuse and recovery contract, including fail-closed sequencing and prohibited manual intervention, beyond target + operation + anchor cite. Cite `knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md`.

Task T003 restates the upstream voluntary-binding acceptance/rejection behavior and positive/negative fixture contract beyond target + operation + anchor cite. Cite `knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md`.

Task T004 restates the upstream cache-identity constraint and diagnostic behavior (`without making them cache-key axes`, nested reason, diagnostic-only bound tests) beyond target + operation + anchor cite. Cite `knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md`.

T001 and T002 precede T003, but their attributed final `ObligationCheckError` and `ObligationEvaluateError` definitions include `BindingConsistency(TestBindingConsistencyError)`, which T003 creates later. Because an entry attributed to an in-progress/done task must already be blue, T001/T002 cannot remain independent batches as planned. Move the shared domain error work into an earlier task or merge/reorder the tasks so the dependency exists first.

The task descriptions and contract attributions disagree: T001 omits `ObligationCheckError`, T002 omits `ObligationEvaluateError`, and T003 omits both error entries despite being assigned them. Align each executable description’s targets and operations with its attributed catalogue entries, or remove/repartition the attributions.

T004 says to update `ObligationFulfillmentCachePort`, and its summary repeats that claim, but the catalogue marks this as an `action: reference` entry whose port surface remains unchanged. Keep its required carrier attribution in `task-contract.json`, but do not instruct the implementer to modify the port.

CN-03 is mapped only to T003, whose description covers voluntary-binding ownership. CN-03 also requires contradictory same-key cache rows to fail closed; that load-bearing clause belongs to the full-key ambiguity work in T001/T002 and is not covered by the current mapping. Add the applicable tasks and anchor citations or repartition the work.

T002 is attributed the add/modify catalogue entries `FulfillmentCacheReevaluationReason`, `ObligationFulfillmentCacheLoad`, and `VerifyCacheError`, but its description targets only `EvaluateTestObligationsInteractor`; it never says to create or modify those domain symbols. Add their target/operation boundary to T002 or repartition the attributions.

T004 is attributed `EdgeResolutionOutcome`, `ObligationFulfillmentCacheEntryError`, and `ResolvedBoundTests`, none of which its description says to add or modify. It also says the `ObligationFulfillmentCachePort` surface is preserved even though the current catalogue marks that entry `modify` and changes `load` to return `ObligationFulfillmentCacheLoad`. Align T004’s executable targets with the attributed catalogue work or reassign those entries.

T002 cannot independently implement its AC-06 recovery path in the declared order. Its new `ObligationFulfillmentCacheLoad` must be returned by the modified `ObligationFulfillmentCachePort::load` and produced by the JSON cache adapter, but both the port and `JsonObligationFulfillmentCacheCodec` are assigned to later T004. In addition, T002’s final `VerifyCacheError` refers to `ObligationFulfillmentCacheEntryError`, also created only by T004. Move these prerequisites into T002/an earlier batch or reorder/merge the tasks.

T001 owns and establishes the final `ObligationEvaluateError`, but that catalogue entry includes `CacheEntry(ObligationFulfillmentCacheEntryError)` while `ObligationFulfillmentCacheEntryError` is created only by later T002. T001 therefore cannot make its owned entry blue and remain independently committable. Move `ObligationEvaluateError` to T002 or create its dependency in/before T001.

T004 restates the upstream contract in “so nested verdict reasons are the only result reason and resolved bound tests are cache-row diagnostics outside cache-key identity.” Replace that sentence-level behavior restatement with target/operation noun phrases plus the existing anchors, as required by `knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md`.
